# Assembly fixtures

`pack-copies.step.gz` (#380) is original synthetic build123d/OCP geometry from
`pack-copies.py`: an enclosure, two separate 60 × 40 × 3 plate products (the
first placed twice), four independent M3×8 hex bolt products, and an M3×10
near miss. Public Specify BOM UDAs state make/buy, different item numbers,
and different default descriptions/optional flags. The latter must not split
interchangeable parts. No outside geometry or source code is included. Shared
under this repository's licence; gzip without a timestamp. Regenerate with
`/Users/paul/repos/quiddity/.venv/bin/python -I tests/fixtures/assembly/pack-copies.py`.

`assembly.step` and `assembly_pin_pmi.step.gz` are described in `tests/assembly_parts.rs`.

`vslot-20x20-100.step.gz` (#212) is pzfreo/dw-examples' `steps/freecad/vslot-20x20-100.step`,
gzip-compressed without changing its STEP bytes: the FreeCAD library's
[Mechanical Parts/Profiles EN/OpenBuilds/V-Slot-20x20-100mm.step](https://github.com/FreeCAD/FreeCAD-library/blob/f5ca01cdcaa2f69b9295a6382719c2d90628780c/Mechanical%20Parts/Profiles%20EN/OpenBuilds/V-Slot-20x20-100mm.step),
added by Charles Fox (`a305030944`, 2026-09-29). It holds three coincident copies of one
profile (part 0 placed twice, and part 1, `Pad`), 55 faces each. Uncompressed SHA-256:
`9c98f6a68872f4ed5f1cc2b514cf3e70ded179b4c1c90a4761adcef3903e874f`.

The V-slot profile is an OpenBuilds design, shared under
[CC BY-SA 4.0](https://openbuildspartstore.com/open-source-license); the FreeCAD library
licenses it under [CC BY 3.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/). This file is
shared under CC BY-SA 4.0 with that attribution.

`lm8uu.step.gz` (#219) is pzfreo/dw-examples' `steps/freecad/lm8uu.step`, gzip-compressed
without changing its STEP bytes: the FreeCAD library's
[Mechanical Parts/Mountings/LM8UU/LM8UU.step](https://github.com/FreeCAD/FreeCAD-library/blob/f5ca01cdcaa2f69b9295a6382719c2d90628780c/Mechanical%20Parts/Mountings/LM8UU/LM8UU.step),
added by hasecilu (`b3ee3aec4c`, 2022-01-04). It holds a linear bearing's metal sleeve (part 1,
`Metal`, ø15 × 24 with a ø12.4 bore) and the inner sleeve that fills the bore (part 0, `Center`,
ø8 bore, 22.4 long). Uncompressed SHA-256:
`1e2fb3226e6df8be982b76e1101e0a8bd2bf2db09a29ea3842beca4c3d29a1a0`. The FreeCAD library licenses
it under [CC BY 3.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/); this file is shared under the
same licence with that attribution.


`pack-small.step.gz` and `pack-handed.step.gz` are synthetic build123d fixtures,
created by `pack-small.py` (run from the repository root). The first has a plate,
two identical cylinders with distinct product names/placements, and a named
screw; the second has an asymmetric blind-hole pattern and its reflection.
Shared under this repository’s licence. `gramil.step.gz` has separate OCL
provenance in `gramil.md` and `LICENSE-gramil`.

`pack-shapes.step.gz` is an original synthetic assembly generated by
`pack-shapes.py` with build123d/OCP. It contains a thin annulus, chamfered dowel,
rounded dowel, untreated cylinder, stepped shaft, and a headed, modelled-thread
fastener with a hexagonal socket. Its neutral `body_N` names are stripped in
structural tests; supply must follow recognised shape evidence. The constant
trapezoidal helical-cut construction is adapted from quiddity-rust's original
`tools/make_thread_fixtures.py`; no third-party model is included. Shared under
this repository's licence, gzip without a timestamp.

`pack-nested.step.gz` is an original synthetic GA fixture from `pack-nested.py`:
60 × 40 × 6 plate, a concentric bushing and a 0.25 mm liner, with generic root
name ASSEMBLY. It exercises distinguishable section/detail item references and
root-title fallback. Shared under this repository's licence.

`bom-small.step.gz` (#267) is an original 13-box synthetic assembly, about 40 KiB
compressed. It carries native product/category records and Specify v0.1.8's
public UDA 1.8 BOM and CAx-IF material property graphs. Its root is ASSEMBLY;
each named part wrapper contains a SOLID leaf, matching real gramil's exporter
structure. Only explicitly answered GRM part numbers are drawing identities;
unanswered SOLID ids remain raw facts. Geometry is not gramil's.
`tools/make_bom_fixture.py` generates it using the real Specify CLI, first
writing the committed `revisions/gramil_assembly.new.step.gz` from Specify
v0.1.8, then a spacer variant, and finally this reduced assembly. The real
assemblies (about 2 MB each) stay in scratch. Public metadata is preserved;
private interview/allocation histories and default manufacturing PMI are omitted.
The box geometry/tool are under this repository's licence. Gramil names and
acceptance-table provenance are attributed to pzfreo/gramil; its actual supplied
licence is OCL v1 (the accompanying `LICENSE-gramil`), not Apache.

Regenerate in an OCP environment, with Specify built from source into scratch:

```sh
python tools/make_bom_fixture.py --specify /scratch/specify-target/release/specify-core \
  --source /scratch/sp-src/tests/fixtures/revisions/gramil_assembly.new.step.gz \
  --work /scratch/bom267 --output tests/fixtures/assembly/bom-small.step.gz
```

`pack-hex-bolts.step.gz` (#351) is original synthetic build123d/OCP geometry:
a 5 mm across-flats hex head, 2 mm high, with a ø3 × 8 mm shank retained as
five cylindrical faces, plus three coplanar head-top faces. Four translated
copies are named `M3×8 hex bolt #1` through `#4`; `rotated fastener` is a
37° axial rotation, and `M3×8 hex bolt #6` has a 10 mm shank as a negative.
The off-origin placements make align choose ±120° head symmetries for the
translated copies, which disagree with the shank face layout. OCP
STEPControl_Writer transferred each body independently: six PRODUCTs,
no NEXT_ASSEMBLY_USAGE_OCCURRENCE. Shared under this repository's licence;
gzip without a timestamp. The one-off generator is intentionally uncommitted.
